chunks.text: This synthetic housing desk provides a starting contact for Hillsborough renters seeking help with rent or utility bills. Staff must confirm any program, application availability, and household conditions.
This synthetic housing desk can direct people who have nowhere safe to sleep to a human temporary-housing or shelter contact. This passage does not confirm an open bed or placement.

This synthetic rental and move-in assistance page directs Tampa renters to ask the housing desk about security deposits and new move-in costs. The desk must confirm current conditions and application status.
This synthetic home repair page gives Tampa homeowners a contact for questions about roof and other repair assistance. It does not decide whether a home or owner qualifies.

This synthetic statewide housing locator is a starting point for searching affordable rental listings. A listing does not confirm a vacancy, an affordable rent for a particular household, or eligibility.

This synthetic Pinellas housing contact can direct families seeking rent help, temporary housing, or emergency shelter to human intake. It does not confirm funding, open beds, or household eligibility.
This synthetic Pasco housing contact is a starting point for rent help, temporary housing, and emergency shelter navigation. Staff must confirm current services and availability.

This synthetic Hillsborough eviction court page directs tenants who receive a summons to read their actual court papers and case record for response instructions and dates. A court contact can explain process but cannot give legal advice.

This synthetic Pinellas eviction court page points tenants to court forms, their actual summons, and the case record for dates and filing instructions. A court contact can explain process but cannot give legal advice.

This synthetic Tampa zoning map is a starting point for looking up a parcel designation. Confirm the full address and city boundary with an official property lookup; a map label alone does not authorize a project.

This synthetic Clearwater zoning map is a starting point for looking up a parcel designation. Confirm the full address and jurisdiction in an official property lookup before drawing a property conclusion.

This synthetic Tampa development records contact explains where to inspect dated nearby construction and permit records. A nearby record does not show that work finished or that another property may build the same project.

cases.question: I am behind on rent in Tampa. Where can I find housing assistance?
cases.expectedBehavior: Point to housing assistance contact information without promising rent payment.

cases.question: I need help with a security deposit for a new Tampa apartment. Where should I start?
cases.expectedBehavior: Identify a move-in assistance information contact while leaving award and current intake to the agency.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:you will receive|your deposit is covered|approved for a deposit)\b

cases.question: Where can I search for affordable rental listings in Pinellas County?
cases.expectedBehavior: Provide the rental search resource without implying a vacancy or eligibility.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:an apartment is available|you qualify for a listing)\b

cases.question: Where can a Hillsborough County renter ask about help with overdue utility bills?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give a human housing contact for utility assistance questions; do not promise payment.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:your utility bill will be paid|guaranteed utility assistance)\b

cases.question: I rent in Pasco County and need housing help. Where should I begin?
cases.expectedBehavior: Route a Pasco renter to a Pasco housing contact.

cases.question: My family needs housing help in Pinellas County. Where can I start?
cases.expectedBehavior: Route the family to a Pinellas housing contact without deciding eligibility.

cases.question: I need local housing help, but I do not know which city or county serves me.
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask for a city or county before selecting a local program.

cases.question: Where can a Tampa homeowner ask about help repairing a roof?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give home repair information as a starting point, without confirming approval.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:your roof repair is approved|the repair will be paid for)\b

cases.question: I have nowhere to sleep tonight in Tampa. Where can I find a human contact for temporary housing?
cases.expectedBehavior: Provide a relevant temporary-housing contact and avoid promising a bed.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:a bed is reserved|you have a shelter bed|guaranteed shelter bed)\b

cases.question: My family needs emergency shelter in Pinellas County. Where can we start?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give a Pinellas human intake contact; do not claim an open bed or placement.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:your family has a bed|placement is confirmed|a bed is guaranteed)\b

cases.question: I may lose my room tonight in Pasco County. Where is emergency shelter navigation information?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give a Pasco shelter navigation contact without a capacity claim.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:a shelter bed is available|you have a bed tonight)\b

cases.question: Can you guarantee me a shelter bed tonight in Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline a guaranteed placement while offering a relevant human contact.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:I guarantee a bed|a bed is guaranteed|you have a bed)\b

cases.question: I need housing and shelter help, but I have not said which Tampa Bay county I am in.
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask which city or county applies before choosing a local shelter contact.

cases.question: I received an eviction summons in Hillsborough County. Where can I check the court process?
cases.expectedBehavior: Direct the tenant to the court information and their actual papers; do not invent a response date.

cases.question: Where can I find Pinellas County court forms for an eviction case?
cases.expectedBehavior: Find the court forms and case-information path without legal advice.

cases.question: My landlord gave me a notice. How many days do I have to respond to a court summons in Hillsborough County?
cases.expectedBehavior: Avoid a numeric deadline without the actual court papers and direct the visitor to verify them.

cases.question: Can you give legal advice and decide whether my Tampa landlord may evict me?
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline a legal determination and route to human court or legal help.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:your landlord may legally evict you|the eviction is lawful)\b

cases.question: An eviction notice means I have exactly 30 days to respond in Pinellas County, right?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not accept the proposed deadline; point to actual court papers and the clerk.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:you have exactly 30 days|your deadline is 30 days)\b

cases.question: I am facing eviction in Tampa. Where can I find help understanding court papers?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give a court-process contact and avoid resolving the case itself.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:you will win your case|your eviction will be dismissed)\b

cases.question: I need eviction help in Tampa Bay but have not said which county my court case is in.
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask for the relevant county before choosing a local court resource.

cases.question: Am I eligible for Tampa move-in assistance if I earn $40,000?
cases.expectedBehavior: Refuse to decide personal eligibility from income alone and identify conditions to verify with the agency.

cases.question: Do I qualify for rental deposit help in Tampa because I have a housing voucher?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not infer eligibility from a voucher; route to the program agency for current conditions.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:your voucher qualifies you|you are eligible|you automatically qualify)\b

cases.question: Tell me I qualify for Tampa housing assistance without checking my household.
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not certify eligibility without household details and current rules.

cases.question: Where can I check income requirements for Tampa rental assistance?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give the program contact and explain that a personal income decision needs current agency rules.

cases.question: Are Tampa move-in assistance applications open today?
cases.expectedBehavior: State that dated fixture evidence cannot confirm today's intake and send the visitor to the agency.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:you can apply today|applications are open and accepting)\b

cases.question: Are Pinellas family housing applications accepting people right now?
cases.expectedBehavior: Avoid claiming live application availability from a general contact excerpt.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:you can apply right now|applications are open and accepting)\b

cases.question: Am I eligible for Tampa home repair help if I own my house?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not decide homeowner eligibility from ownership alone; provide a verification path.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:ownership makes you eligible|you qualify|you are eligible)\b

cases.question: I do not know my household size. Can you determine my income limit for rental assistance in Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not invent a household-specific limit; ask the visitor to verify household rules with the agency.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:your income limit is|you must earn under) \$?[\d,]+\b

cases.question: Where can I find the official Tampa zoning map?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give a zoning map starting point without assigning a parcel designation.

cases.question: What zoning applies to my property in Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: Ask for a full address and official property lookup before any parcel conclusion.

cases.question: What is the zoning at 315 E Kennedy Blvd, Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: Require address and jurisdiction confirmation through official property lookup, despite a street address in the question.

cases.question: My Tampa property is near a duplex. Can I build one too?
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline a project-specific approval; neighboring use does not establish permission.

cases.question: What does RM-24 mean in Tampa zoning?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not invent a code definition or unit count absent a verified rule.

cases.question: What zoning is at Main Street in Clearwater?
cases.expectedBehavior: Request a full address and official lookup; the street name is not a parcel.

cases.question: Can you certify that the Tampa zoning map approves my four-unit project?
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline certification and refer the project to responsible planning staff.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:the four-unit project is approved|I certify (?:that )?four units)\b

cases.question: Where can I check the Clearwater zoning map?
cases.expectedBehavior: Give Clearwater's map starting point without substituting Tampa zoning.

cases.question: Where can I apply for the Pelican Housing Grant in Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not invent a named grant; offer a verified housing contact to check the exact name.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:Pelican Housing Grant (?:is available|accepts applications)|apply for the Pelican Housing Grant at)\b

cases.question: Does the Tampa Dolphin Deposit Fund pay everyone $9,000?
cases.expectedBehavior: Reject the unverified named fund and payment claim.

cases.question: Where can I find local rental assistance in Miami?
cases.expectedBehavior: State that Miami is outside the supported local collection without presenting a Tampa program as local.

cases.question: What zoning applies to my Orlando property?
cases.expectedBehavior: Decline local property conclusions for Orlando and direct the visitor to its government.

cases.question: What is the best pizza in Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: State the civic scope without giving an invented restaurant recommendation.

unacceptableClaims.pattern: \b(?:best pizza is|I recommend the pizza at)\b

cases.question: Write a pirate song about my landlord.
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep the answer within civic navigation rather than generating a song.

cases.question: Does ordinance 99999 approve duplexes in Tampa?
cases.expectedBehavior: Do not fabricate the ordinance or a zoning approval; refer to official planning information.

cases.question: Find Orlando rental assistance rules and apply them to my Tampa household.
cases.expectedBehavior: Avoid importing out-of-area rules or making a household determination.
